**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the closing overlay mode during the exit animation**

When the file picker or content-search overlay closes via its shortcut, backdrop, or result selection, `reduceCommandPaletteUiState` immediately resets `state.mode` to `"command"`. Keeping this subtree alive for Base UI's 200 ms ending transition therefore replaces the visible picker/search contents with `OpenCommandPaletteDialog` before the popup fades out, producing a flash of the wrong UI and, for content search, a height change during the new closing animation. Preserve the rendered mode until the exit completes rather than rendering directly from the reset mode.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
